Born at Mansfield 13 September 1764. Lived at South Kingstown, Rhode Island, where he married Ruth Peckham,
then at Weybridge, Vermont, and finally at Bangor, Franklin County, New York.
Bangor's first church, the Presbyterian, was organized in his barn near Cook's Corners in 1809.
His gravestone gives his death as 27 February 1837.
Born at South Kingstown, Rhode Island, 2 February 1777.
She married Constant Southworth at Weybridge, Vermont, on 3 September 1793, and they settled at Bangor,
Franklin County, New York, where she died on 12 June 1850.
She is buried in the Southworth family cemetery there.
